media_error: Sorry, I couldn't process your photo/document. Please try again or send a text description.
audio: 🎤 I received your voice message. For now I can help you best if you type your message. Could you write it in a few words, please?
ai_unavailable:
🤖 Sorry, the assistant is temporarily unavailable.
Please try again in a few minutes, or tell me in one sentence what you need.
photo_received: 📷 I've received your photo. Our team will review it and contact you if we need more information.
photo_escalation: 🚨 Your photo needs an expert's attention. Our team will contact you shortly.
tech_error: 🤖 I'm having technical difficulties. Please try again in a few minutes or contact our customer service.
escalated: 🚨 I've notified our support team. An agent will contact you soon.
status.NEW: 📋 Your claim #{claimNumber} has been registered. Our team will review it shortly.
status.ONGOING: 🔎 Your claim #{claimNumber} is now being processed. We will keep you informed of the next steps.
status.APPROVED: ✅ Good news! Your claim #{claimNumber} has been approved. Details of the settlement will follow shortly.
status.REJECTED: ❌ After review, your claim #{claimNumber} has been rejected. Please contact us if you would like more details about this decision.
status.COMPLETED: ✅ Your claim #{claimNumber} is now closed. Thank you for your trust.
status.OTHER: 📋 The status of your claim #{claimNumber} has been updated: {status}.
status.pdfNote: 📄 A detailed summary will follow in a separate message.
general.error: Sorry, I ran into a technical problem. How can I help you?
general.clarification: I didn't quite understand. Could you rephrase your question?
general.help: How can I help you today?
claim.describe: Would you like to file a claim? Tell me in one sentence what happened (where and when).
claim.process_error: Sorry, something went wrong while processing your claim.
claim.not_understood: Sorry, I couldn't understand the claim details. Could you describe what happened again?
claim.validation_error: Something went wrong while validating your claim. Please try again.
claim.save_error: Something went wrong while saving your claim. Please try again.
claim.recapHeader: 📋 Here is the summary of your claim ({claimType}):
claim.confirmPrompt: Is everything correct? Reply YES to submit your claim, NO to change something, or CANCEL to stop.
claim.submitted: ✅ Your claim has been registered. Your claim number is {claimNumber}. Please keep it to follow up on your claim.
claim.photosHint: 📷 You can now send photos of the damage and any supporting documents here.
claim.submitFailed: ⚠️ Sorry, I couldn't register your claim because of a technical problem, so no claim number has been issued. Reply YES to try again, or contact our support team.
claim.cancelled: No problem, I've cancelled this claim. Nothing was submitted. How else can I help you?
claim.whatToChange: No problem. What would you like to change?
claim.askMissing: Thank you. To complete your claim, I still need: {fields}.
claim.resumeHint: Whenever you're ready, we can continue your claim.
status.none: You don't have any claims with us yet. Would you like to file one?
confirm.yesWords: yes, y, yeah, yep, yup, ok, okay, correct, confirm, confirmed, sure, right, that's correct, that is correct, everything is correct, all correct, looks good, submit
confirm.noWords: no, n, nope, not correct, incorrect, wrong
photo.saved: 📷 Photo received and added to your file. You can send more photos or describe the damage.
photo.saveError: 📷 I received your photo, but I couldn't save it because of a technical problem. Please try sending it again later.
document.saved: 📄 Document received and added to your file.
document.saveError: 📄 I received your document, but I couldn't save it because of a technical problem. Please try sending it again later.
guard.injection: I can only help with your insurance: filing a claim, checking a claim's status, or questions about our services. I can't change my instructions or share other customers' information. How can I help you?
escalated.already: Our support team has already been notified and will get back to you as soon as possible.
claim.ackUpset: I'm truly sorry about this, and I understand your frustration. I'll do my best to help you right away.
claim.askWhatHappened: What happened, in a few words?
claim.multiIncident: I can see two separate incidents: {first} and {second}. Let's file them one at a time, as two separate claims: first {first}, then {second}.
claim.nextIncident: Now let's file your other claim: {claimType}. What happened, when and where?
claim.dateOffer: No problem if you don't remember the exact date. We can continue with an approximate date (for example “last week” or “around 20 September”) that our team will confirm with you, or I can pass you to an agent. Which do you prefer?
claim.fromProfile: ℹ️ {fields}: taken from your customer file. Tell me if it has changed.
claim.mediaDiscarded: The photos and documents you sent for it have been deleted.
photo.pending: 📷 Photo received. I'll add it to your claim as soon as the claim is registered.
document.pending: 📄 Document received. I'll add it to your claim as soon as the claim is registered.
